fusions.name: Jagged Footing
fusions.desc: Jagged stone tears at every enemy within 2.5 tiles for 7 earth damage and leaves them [Bleeding] for 5 seconds, which worsens while they move. It holds 3 charges, and each kill returns one.

fusions.name: Deadfall
fusions.desc: Drops a deadfall stone on the target for 30 damage, and every other enemy within 3.5 tiles takes 80% of that.

fusions.name: Covered Pit
fusions.desc: Digs a pit at the nearest enemy. It waits up to 30 seconds, and the first 3 enemies to come within 2.5 tiles each take 16 damage in a blast around it.

fusions.name: Cornered Ground
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, your armour rises by 10%.
